comment: The description implies that a Computable Decision Support Engine directly evaluates a patient’s record and delivers recommendations at the point of care. In practice, decision support may be embedded in applications, invoked through standardised services, or distributed across rules engines and knowledge services.

anchor.note: p.25-26 l.Lines 66-73 read as the printed page; section 2.1.2 agrees

public.text: The description implies that a Computable Decision Support Engine directly evaluates a patient’s record and delivers recommendations at the point of care. In practice, decision support may be embedded in applications, invoked through standardised services, or distributed across rules engines and knowledge services.
public.suggestedRevision: Use implementation-neutral wording: “Computable decision-support capabilities evaluate relevant patient and contextual data against governed computable guidance and make recommendations, alerts, or assessments available to authorised consuming applications.”
